name: Adam M. Satnick
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Cannabis Law, Civil Litigation
about: Adam M. Satnick is a founding partner at Satnick Lau LLP in Los Angeles, California, providing representation across every city in Los Angeles County. His versatile practice spans business and real estate litigation, cannabis law, intellectual property disputes and estate and trust litigation in both plaintiff and defense civil litigation. Serving a diverse clientele, he brings deep regional knowledge and strategic focus to high-stakes legal matters throughout Los Angeles.

Mr. Satnick has extensive experience advising clients through complex commercial, real estate and general litigation challenges. His practice includes successfully handling breach of contract, fraud, breach of fiduciary duty, securities law and a broad range of real property disputes. Whether representing plaintiffs or defendants, he combines rigorous analysis with assertive advocacy to protect his clients' commercial interests, resolve intricate legal conflicts and deliver outcome-driven results in complex courtroom battles.

Earning his Bachelor’s degree in philosophy with a minor in political science from Pepperdine University, Mr. Satnick proceeded to receive his Juris Doctor from the Southwestern University School of Law. Licensed to practice in California since 2015, he is also admitted to the United States District Court for the Central District of California. His strong analytical foundation in philosophy, combined with rigorous legal training, fuels the precise, persuasive advocacy he brings to federal and state courts.

Prioritizing a client-first, pragmatic approach, Mr. Satnick aligns aggressive courtroom tactics with broader commercial goals. By identifying core leverage points early, he eliminates procedural inefficiencies to control litigation costs while keeping clients closely informed at every strategic turn. He adapts dynamically to evolving case developments, translating complicated legal exposure into actionable risk assessments. This proactive responsiveness ensures business owners and individuals navigate high-friction disputes with continuous clarity, minimal operational disruption and complete confidence in their legal trajectory.
